summary: Record reviewed S6 lower-candidate refusal and failed-fence retry subsets without closing manual recovery. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: This records acceptance evidence and limits only; promotion workflows did not change.

api.reason: Existing promotion, preflight, fence and local join-offer operations were exercised without a contract change.

roadmap.reason: The S6 subsets do not complete Phase 4 or the manual-recovery gate.

state.reason: Core owns authority replicas, promotion transfer, fence proof, membership, restriction and pending VM-update state.
state.record: Existing Core pool-peer authority replica, transfer, fence-proof and membership records plus the master pool-vms pending-update record remain authoritative and are reported to a replacement Controller through inventory.

verification.method: S6-9 records a lower signed authority candidate refused before activation because a reachable member held newer authority, then ordinary signed convergence after old-master restoration. S6-6 records reachable-master preflight refusal with unchanged durable promotion state. S6-5/S6-10 records a candidate-only fence fault with no activation/repoint, then the same operation's fresh bound fence result, promotion/repoint, and returned former-master authority-write refusal while restricted. S6-15 records ordinary former-master rejoin with restriction clear, verified current replica and accepted empty-VM inventory. S6-12 records a debugger-held durable pending update, matching signed candidate replica, per-VM preflight block while the owner is off, and same-operation recovery to revision one before fixture deletion. No workload-continuity, ownership-conflict resolution or full S6 claim is made.
